description:
Build "The Forge" dashboard — engineering velocity and execution metrics. This is the richest dashboard with ~90% of ideal data available today.

**Theme: Foundry**
Warm tones: deep charcoal background with amber, orange, and molten gold accents. Forge instrumentation aesthetic — temperature gauges, heat indicators, flowing metal animations. Velocity chart as rising sparks. Conveys intensity and productivity.

**Metrics — Available Now (dataSource: live, ~90% coverage):**
- Throughput: completed/created items (7-day, 30-day), net delta
- Velocity: 8-week trailing chart with weekly completion counts
- Timing: avg and median cycle time, lead time, queue wait (hours)
- Blocking: currently blocked count, blocked ratio, top 10 reasons with frequency, avg block duration
- Agent performance: total executions, success rate, failure rate, follow-up rate, avg execution minutes, avg workshop rounds
- Review quality: rounds completed, avg evidence per round, verification rate, request-more rate, avg review duration
- Initiative health: per-initiative total/completed/in-progress/blocked, scope creep ratio
- Dependency graph: edges, blocked items, unblocked items (critical path)
- Governance: active executions vs max concurrent, queue depth vs max, circuit-broken items, estimated queued cost
- Backlog composition: items by status (backlog/researching/ready/queued/in_progress/completed/failed) and kind (idea/research/fix/execute/chore)
- Estimated weeks remaining

**Metrics — Ideal/Future (dataSource: gap):**
- Cost per completed item (actual AI token spend per execution)
- Contributor leaderboard (which agents/humans completed most)
- Burndown chart per initiative (requires historical snapshots)
- Predicted completion dates with confidence intervals
- Flow efficiency — active work time vs total time ratio

**Layout concept:** Central velocity chart (the forge's "fire"), flanked by gauge-style widgets for blocked ratio and success rate. Initiative progress bars below like ingots being forged. Blocking reasons as ranked list. Agent stats sidebar.
name: command-center-forge-page
title: Build The Forge dashboard — engineering velocity with Foundry theme
